cues.text: Outside the gates, Akihiko, Yukari and Junpei wait.
Through the bars, the school sits dark.
With them, the hero and Mitsuru.
Everything turns green. The school's windows twist and multiply.
The building stretches up into a green sky.
Huge blocks of stone tilt and rise. A glowing clock face splits.
The tower climbs, glowing clocks in its walls.
Its stacked walls rise past the clouds.
At the top, a crescent moon.
